title: ReasoningProfile
description: Explicit reasoning profile controlling which reasoning strategy the runtime adapter applies to an agent invocation. Implements PATTERNS E3.1.

id.description: Stable profile identifier used by the adapter registry.

description.description: Human-readable description of when to use this profile.

selectionCriteria.description: Heuristics that trigger automatic profile selection.

taskComplexityMin.description: Minimum task complexity score (0-1) to use this profile.

uncertaintyThreshold.description: Minimum uncertainty score that triggers this profile.

applicableAgentIds.description: Agent IDs that default to this profile.

highRiskDeliverable.description: Whether this profile applies to high-risk deliverables.

promptDirectives.description: Prompt modifiers injected into the system envelope for this strategy.

systemPrefix.description: Text prepended to the system prompt.

chainOfThoughtDepth.description: How deeply to elaborate reasoning steps.

selfCritiqueEnabled.description: Whether an internal critique pass is injected.

debateRounds.description: Number of pro/con debate rounds for the debate strategy.

verifierEnabled.description: Whether a verifier pass runs after the primary response.

performanceHistory.description: Tracked success rate by task type for adaptive selection.
